title: Working Student Hardware Engineering & Product Design (m/f/d)
description:
About the role

Modern conflict runs on the electromagnetic spectrum, and the systems that listen to it have to survive the real world. Datacept builds cognitive electronic warfare systems: passive wideband sensing, AI-driven signal analysis, deployed at ports, stadiums, critical infrastructure, and military sites.

Our systems are already in use with customers. Now the hardware has to scale: produced repeatedly, refined, and trusted in the field.

We are looking for a working student who can take it there: someone who designs the part in CAD and then makes it on the machine.

Your role

You are the hands of our hardware team. You take our existing hardware and develop it into the next generation: robust, manufacturable, well-designed. You work directly with the founders and the engineers, you make design decisions, and you build your own parts in our workshop instead of waiting for someone else to.

What you will do

  • Develop our current hardware into a series-ready next generation: construction, assemblies, tolerances, materials

  • Product design: enclosures, ergonomics, surfaces, mounting, and ease of assembly in the field

  • Create CAD models, technical drawings, and bills of materials

  • Build prototypes and samples yourself on our in-house CNC mill and 3D printers, plus assembly and functional tests

  • Test hardware under real conditions, learn from failures, and iterate quickly

  • Coordinate with suppliers and manufacturing partners on what works in series production

How we work

  • Build, don't just draw. An idea becomes a part in your hand before it becomes a document.

  • Fast learners over specific backgrounds. We care more about how quickly you pick up new skills than where you have worked before.

  • Intellectual honesty. The right answer matters more than being right. If the test shows the design fails, we change the design.

  • Ownership of outcomes. You organise your own time, focus on what matters, and cut out inefficiencies. Nobody manages your calendar for you.

  • Not building in a vacuum. You stay connected to the founders, the software and RF team, and the sites where our systems run, so that all the pieces fit together in the field.

Requirements

  • You study mechanical engineering, product design, mechatronics, or a similar field

  • You have strong CAD skills (e.g. SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Inventor)

  • You have built real hardware, not only modelled it

  • You have operated a CNC mill, or you are ready to learn it on ours

  • You understand design for manufacturing

  • You go from idea to prototype on your own, and you ask for help when it speeds things up rather than when you are stuck

  • You are available up to 20 hours per week during the semester, more during semester breaks if you want

Helpful, not required

  • Basic CAM knowledge (e.g. Fusion 360 CAM)

  • Experience with FDM or resin 3D printing, turning, sheet metal, or composites

  • Electronics basics: wiring, sensors, integrating PCBs and antennas into enclosures

  • Projects you built yourself: maker work, Formula Student, university teams, a portfolio

  • Rendering and visual design

  • Experience with rugged or outdoor hardware

  • You want to contribute to Europe's technological sovereignty in a domain where it is currently lacking

Benefits

  • Work on a real product that ends up in real deployments

  • Your own workshop with a CNC mill and 3D printers: design a part in the morning, hold it in your hand by the afternoon

  • Flexible hours around lectures and exams

  • Compensation: €16–20 per hour

  • 6-month contract with the option to extend

  • Perspective for a thesis or a long-term role as we grow

  • Insight into real RF hardware and field deployments

  • Workshop and main workplace in Horneburg (R&D). Days without hands-on work can be done from our Hamburg HafenCity HQ

Hiring process

  1. Intro call (15 min, remote): who you are, why Datacept

  2. Project conversation (45 min): bring what you built (CAD, photos, parts), and we start with a small design challenge right away

  3. Final meeting in person at our workshop in Horneburg with the founders

  4. Reference check and offer within 48 hours

About Datacept

Datacept GmbH, founded in Hamburg in 2025, builds cognitive electronic warfare systems for spectrum awareness, counter-drone defence, and the protection of critical infrastructure. Our platform unifies passive wideband sensing, AI-driven signal analysis, and the RF data infrastructure that ties them together.

We have raised pre-seed capital and are backed by German federal funding. We work with critical infrastructure operators, defence agencies, and NATO partners to give Europe the intelligence we need in the electromagnetic spectrum.

Unser ambitioniertes Team aus Medizin, Technologie und Business arbeitet daran, die Krankenhausverwaltung nachhaltig zu verändern.

Warum diese Rolle zählt

Dein PEPP-Wissen: nicht für eine Klinik, sondern für viele. Du kennst die DKR-Psych im Detail, weißt, wo im Klinikalltag Erlöse verloren gehen, und hast schon mit dem MD über Fälle diskutiert? Bei Valova sorgst Du dafür, dass unsere KI so gut kodiert wie Du, und bringst sie in psychiatrische und psychosomatische Kliniken in ganz Deutschland.

Die Kodierung in Psychiatrie und Psychosomatik folgt eigenen Regeln. Therapieeinheiten, ergänzende Tagesentgelte, Fallzusammenführungen und Personalvorgaben machen PEPP zu einem der anspruchsvollsten Systeme im Krankenhaus, und jede Lücke in Dokumentation oder Kodierung kostet Erlöse und führt zu MD-Prüfungen. Valova ist gebaut, um das zu ändern, aber nur, wenn unsere Software PEPP so gut versteht wie die besten Kodierfachkräfte. Genau dafür brauchen wir Dich.

Was Du bewirkst, siehst Du schwarz auf weiß: in Fällen, die vollständig kodiert sind und in der Prüfung bestehen, in weniger Streit mit dem MD und in Stunden, die Kodierteams und Therapeut:innen zurückgewinnen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Valova PEPP beibringen: Du übersetzt ICD-10-GM, OPS Kapitel 9, DKR-Psych, PEPP-Katalog und PsychPV/PPP-RL in klare Kodierregeln, Plausibilitätsprüfungen und Testfälle, inklusive Therapieeinheiten, ergänzender Tagesentgelte und Fallzusammenführungen.

  • KI-Vorschläge prüfen: Du bewertest die Kodiervorschläge von Valova und markierst, was stimmt und was nicht. So wird die Qualität messbar besser.

  • Auf dem Laufenden halten: Du arbeitest Katalogänderungen zum Jahreswechsel und neue Rechtsprechung ein.

  • Kliniken begleiten: Du betreust Pilot- und Rolloutprojekte vor Ort und remote, schulst Kodierfachkräfte, Medizincontrolling sowie ärztliches und therapeutisches Personal und bist nach dem Go-live die erste fachliche Ansprechperson. Dafür bist Du rund 20–30 % Deiner Zeit unterwegs.

  • Brücke bauen: Du gibst Feedback aus dem Klinikalltag strukturiert an unsere Produktentwicklung weiter.

Was Du mitbringst

  • Mehrjährige Praxis in der PEPP-Kodierung, z. B. als Kodierfachkraft, im Medizincontrolling einer psychiatrischen oder psychosomatischen Einrichtung, beim Medizinischen Dienst oder ärztlich in der Psychiatrie

  • Sichere Kenntnisse in ICD-10-GM, OPS, DKR-Psych und dem PEPP-Entgeltsystem

  • Freude daran, Wissen verständlich weiterzugeben, und fließendes Deutsch

Schön, aber kein Muss:

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We're looking for an M&A Intern to join manda, iwoca's M&A platform. This is a paid off-cycle internship of up to 6 months, for someone who wants to build a long-term career in fintech - Hybrid in London.

manda is where AI meets Mergers & Acquisitions. Over the last months we've built a proposition for buying and selling UK small businesses. Our first deals are done, and our pipeline is growing across both sell-side and buy-side. Most M&A firms shy away from the sub-£10m EV segment because information asymmetry, lack of knowledge, and low transaction sizes make it hard to serve profitably. iwoca has 150,000+ SME customers in the UK and a track record of building clean, automated processes, and manda is leveraging that to build an M&A platform that serves this market properly.

Your edge as an intern: you'll work on live sub-£10m transactions from week one, not pitch books for deals you'll never touch. You'll see the full deal lifecycle (origination, diligence, execution, close) inside a venture small enough that the work you do moves the business, and you'll have AI and automation as leverage rather than as a side project.

The team

You'll sit inside the manda Deal Team and work directly with the people running the platform: our sell-side and buy-side Transaction Managers, our Due Diligence Manager, and the Venture Lead. The team is small enough that you'll be in the room for real decisions on live deals, and the tooling we use (CRM, VDR, AI automated workflows) is being built in parallel by the same people you'll be working alongside.

The role

The internship is split into two phases to give you both breadth across the deal engine and depth on a project you own.

Phase 1: Core M&A Operations (first 2 months). You'll get to try out several of our live workstreams, and we'll decide your final placement based on deal flow, team priorities and where you add the most. You'll do real day-to-day work supporting the team where it matters most. Workstreams include:

  • Sell-side execution: supporting our sell-side Transaction Managers across the deal lifecycle. Qualifying inbound and outbound vendor leads, preparing materials, populating Virtual Data Rooms, and coordinating buyer Q&A.

  • Buy-side execution: supporting our buy-side Transaction Manager managing the live pipeline of searchers and acquirers. Qualifying buyer mandates, matching them to live sell-side opportunities, and helping move deals through to LOI.

  • Due diligence support: working with our DD Manager on company valuation and diligence for live sell-side mandates. Turning raw SME data into clear reports on business model, financial position, and fair valuation.

  • Origination: identifying SMEs likely to sell, running our "likely seller" models against iwoca's customer base, and converting matches into mandates.

  • Product, data & AI: turning manual workflows into automated ones, mapping the data schema for our "Digital IM", and building AI-enabled tooling that gives our Transaction Managers leverage. You'll work closely with the Venture Lead on this.

Phase 2: The project (months 3-6). Once you've built the foundation, you'll scope a project with the Venture Lead to solve a real problem or seize an opportunity you've identified during Phase 1. You'll spend the rest of the internship executing it end-to-end with full ownership and regular check-ins. Examples of the kind of project we'd back: a model that scores acquisition targets against a buyer's mandate, an AI workflow that drafts a first-pass IM from raw accounts, or a structured outbound channel into a new vendor segment.

Who you are

You're interested in M&A, FinTech, or building things from scratch, and you want to do all three at once. Most importantly, you're smart, motivated, humble, and have a growth mindset.

  • You are need-driven. You take whatever is in front of you and move it forward, whether that's fixing a broken spreadsheet, calling a vendor, or cleaning up CRM data. You don't wait to be told what's important.

  • You are financially literate. You can read a P&L and a balance sheet, spot what's odd, and ask the question that surfaces the real story behind the numbers.

  • You are tech-curious. You bring your own stack, you're already using AI tools to multiply your output, and you treat any manual workflow you see as a candidate for automation.

  • You are a clear communicator. M&A runs on trust. You write professional emails, you're not afraid to pick up the phone, and you can hold a conversation with a business owner about the company they spent 30 years building.

The requirements

  • Available for a full-time, off-cycle placement of up to 6 months.

  • Strong academic background, open to all disciplines.

  • Any experience, projects, or initiatives that show genuine M&A, FinTech, or entrepreneurial interest. We care more about evidence of initiative than a polished CV.

  • Bonus: experience working with SME data, financing, or M&A workflows.

The salary & conversion

This is a paid internship with annual compensation of £30k. If it goes well and there's a fit on both sides, we'd convert you into a permanent role on the manda team, with compensation re-benchmarked against the new position.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

Role Overview

Harvey is building a best-in-class go-to-market engine, and we're looking for a GTM Systems Administrator to join the GTM Systems team and help scale the systems that power both our pipeline and our customer experience. You'll take on a variety of projects across the full GTM lifecycle, from how we source, enrich, and route leads at the top of the funnel to how we support and engage customers through Zendesk and our Customer Success platforms. This is not a traditional RevOps or Salesforce admin role: we expect this person to work AI-first, using AI tools and agents to build, automate, and maintain systems that would traditionally require engineering support or manual admin work. What You Have

Our pharmacy is busy. Really busy. It is a lively, energetic environment where things move quickly, teamwork is essential and no two days are quite the same. If you enjoy being on your feet, working alongside others and being part of a team where everyone has a role to play, you could feel right at home.

Behind every prescription we process is a patient relying on us to get things right. Whether you are packing medication, dispensing prescriptions or completing final accuracy checks, your contribution matters.

We are recruiting across several positions within our pharmacy team, with opportunities for both experienced pharmacy professionals and individuals looking to enter the industry.

Pharmacy Assistant

An excellent entry point into the pharmacy sector, with no previous pharmacy experience required.

You will support the day-to-day operations of our busy pharmacy, including preparing orders, packing medication, supporting stock management and helping ensure prescriptions are processed accurately and efficiently.

We are looking for individuals who are organised, reliable, comfortable with repetitive tasks and enjoy working in a hands-on, fast-paced environment.

Trainee Pharmacy Dispenser

Looking to develop a career in pharmacy? This could be your opportunity.

No previous dispensing experience is required. You will receive training and support as you develop the knowledge and practical skills needed to work within our dispensing team.

You will learn about prescription processing, medication handling, accuracy, pharmacy procedures and the importance of maintaining high standards of patient safety.

Pharmacy Dispenser

For individuals with an existing dispensing qualification and experience working within a pharmacy environment.

You will support the safe and accurate dispensing of prescriptions, working closely with pharmacists, technicians and the wider pharmacy team.

You will need excellent attention to detail, a strong understanding of pharmacy procedures and the ability to maintain accuracy while managing high prescription volumes.

Accuracy Checking Dispenser

We are looking for qualified and experienced Accuracy Checking Dispensers who can help maintain the high standards of accuracy and patient safety expected within our pharmacy.

You will undertake accuracy checking duties within the scope of your qualification, training and authorisation, supporting the efficient processing of prescriptions and working collaboratively with the wider team.

Accuracy Checking Technician (ACT)

For qualified Pharmacy Technicians with an accredited accuracy checking qualification and current GPhC registration.

You will play an important role in maintaining dispensing accuracy, supporting pharmacy operations and ensuring our processes meet the required professional and regulatory standards.

You will bring confidence, attention to detail and the ability to work effectively in a high-volume dispensing environment.

We know that traditional interviews do not always give people the best opportunity to demonstrate what they can do.

That is why we are taking a slightly different approach.

Our Pharmacy Assessment Centre is designed to be an engaging, practical and interactive experience where you can demonstrate your abilities, meet members of the Montu team and gain a better understanding of our working environment.

You can expect a combination of practical and team-based activities designed to assess skills relevant to working within our pharmacy, including:

  • Attention to detail and accuracy

  • Literacy and the ability to follow written instructions

  • Working effectively with others

  • Organisation and the ability to follow processes

  • Speed and efficiency without compromising accuracy

  • Communication and problem-solving

We are not expecting everyone to arrive with pharmacy knowledge, particularly those applying for our entry-level opportunities.

We are interested in how you approach tasks, how you work with others and whether you have the right attitude to succeed in our environment.

What happens after the assessment centre?

Candidates who successfully complete the assessment centre will be invited to attend a further on-site interview at Montu on a later date.

Please note that attendance at the assessment centre does not guarantee an interview or offer of employment.

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for people who genuinely want to be part of a team making a difference.

Our ideal candidates will be:

  • Patient-focused: You understand that the work you do has a direct impact on the people relying on our service.

  • Detail-oriented: Accuracy matters, particularly when working with medication.

  • Comfortable in a busy environment: You enjoy an energetic workplace and can remain focused when things get hectic.

  • Reliable and hardworking: You take pride in doing your job well and supporting the people around you.

  • Team players: You understand that pharmacy operations depend on people working together.

  • Adaptable: You are comfortable learning new processes and responding to change.

  • Eager to learn: Whether you are new to pharmacy or already experienced, you are motivated to develop your skills.

You do not need to be the loudest person in the room or have years of experience to succeed here.

What matters is your work ethic, your attention to detail and your commitment to doing things properly.

About Montu

Montu is a leading medical cannabis company working to improve access to cannabis-based medicines for patients across the UK.

Through our specialist clinical services and pharmacy operations, we support patients receiving prescribed cannabis-based medicines for a range of eligible medical conditions.

Our multidisciplinary teams bring together clinicians, pharmacists, pharmacy technicians, dispensers and operational colleagues, all working towards the same goal: delivering safe, effective and patient-centred care.

We are a rapidly growing organisation, and our pharmacy is at the heart of what we do.

Every prescription represents a patient who is depending on us. From the moment a prescription reaches our pharmacy to the moment medication is dispatched, every member of our team plays an important role in that patient journey.

We are proud to be helping shape an evolving area of healthcare, and we want people who are excited to be part of that journey.

Why Join Montu?

Joining Montu means becoming part of a growing organisation where your work has purpose and your contribution makes a difference.

  • Career progression within our growing pharmacy operations

  • A supportive and collaborative team environment

Further information about the benefits applicable to each role will be provided during the recruitment process.

title: Customer Success Manager, SMB
description:
About Hiya

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.

About the Role

Most people don’t answer calls from numbers they don’t recognise, and that costs legitimate businesses customers. Hiya Connect Branded Call fixes this by showing a verified brand name, logo and call reason on outbound calls, so the right calls get answered.

As our Account Manager, SMB, you’ll own the relationships with a fast-growing base of small and mid-sized businesses across the UK and Europe. You’ll keep them renewing, help them grow and work with Sales, Product and Support to shape how Hiya serves this market.

We’re excited about you because you’re the kind of person who treats a book of 300 accounts as 300 chances to make a difference. You decide where your time matters most, act before problems become churn, and enjoy building the playbook rather than just following one.

What You’ll Do

  • Own a portfolio of 300+ SMB accounts, with full accountability for renewals and expansion

  • Hold renewal, pricing and growth conversations in German, French or Spanish as well as English

  • Triage your book daily: decide which accounts need you and which can run digitally

  • Reach at-risk customers early, before the conversation turns to churn

  • Spot expansion signals (usage growth, new teams, new use cases) and turn them into upsells

  • Forecast your portfolio and keep CRM records accurate

  • Share patterns from your book that help Sales, Product and Support improve the SMB experience

What We Are Looking For

  • Demonstrated ownership of renewals, expansions, or quota

  • Commercial instinct - able to spot a growth opportunity, build a case for it, and close it without heavy support

  • Clear, direct communication with customers and internal stakeholders

  • Comfortable working independently in an environment where not every process is fully defined

You’ll Likely Stand Out If You Have

  • Experience managing SMB or mid-market customers

  • Experience across UK and European markets

  • More than one of German, French or Spanish, or another European language

  • A knack for keeping engagement personal at scale

  • Exposure to conversation intelligence, caller ID or communications technology

Role details

  • Status: Full-time

  • Type: Hybrid

  • Location: London, United Kingdom

  • Travel: Up to 25%

  • Department: Sales – Customer Success

  • Reports to: Sr. Manager: Customer Success, UK & EU

 

Come Work With Us!

We're building a team with diverse perspectives, identities, and professional experiences. We evaluate candidates through a business lens and believe that diversity and unique viewpoints make our company stronger, more dynamic, and a great place to build a career.

We've been recognized by Built In, GeekWire, Comparably, G2, Forbes, and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 for our culture, innovation, leadership, compensation, and more. At Hiya, we're a people-centric company focused on helping each employee grow both personally and professionally. You'll love working here if you're looking for an innovative challenge that's disrupting an industry. Come join us!

description:
Who we are

Hexa is a venture studio. Since 2011, we've built more than 60 companies, including 3 unicorns. Every year, our startup studio, Hexa Start, creates 12 companies from scratch, and our accelerator, Hexa Sprint, funds several dozen more. Each Start company begins with a CEO and a CTO we recruit ourselves: finding them is our core business.

That's where you come in. 👀

The role

Our partners bring the ideas. What turns an idea into a real company is the people who build it, so finding the right founders is Hexa's core business. That's your job: convincing aspiring founders to join us, walking them through a life-changing decision, and putting them in front of the right partner at the right time.

Our marketing team builds and nurtures the reservoir of future founders. You turn it into a pipeline for each open role (say, a CTO for a cybersecurity project with experience in LLM-built attacks), run the search with the partner leading the project, assess, and close. Laure, your peer, does the same for each company's first employees.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll need the business sense to read an idea and know what kind of founder it calls for, and a sharp eye for entrepreneurial profiles: you can tell a true entrepreneur from a strong manager, even when both look great on paper.

What you'll actually do

  • Source, hands-on: inbound comes first, but you roll up your sleeves and reach out to everyone who looks on track to start something, before anyone else does,

  • Build a pipeline for every open founder role within two weeks, from your own sourcing, the marketing reservoir and our scoring agents,

  • Own the founder scorecard with the partners and fine-tune it every quarter against real hiring outcomes,

  • Interview, assess and close demanding, sometimes hesitant candidates, alongside partners and our CTO,

  • Tell marketing and community what each search is missing, down to the event it needs,

  • Act as product owner of our recruiting stack (Ashby, sourcing tools, AI agents), and call in agencies when a search runs short.

What we're looking for

  • 2 to 7 years in recruiting or talent acquisition, close to founders: fast-growing startup, VC fund, accelerator, studio, or founder and executive search

  • You know what makes a strong founder, and you have examples rather than generalities

  • A track record of closing senior or founder-level candidates, with numbers to back it

  • You build trust fast, and you can challenge a candidate without putting them off

  • You're as comfortable testing an agent or optimizing a workflow as building a relationship

  • You have the standing to disagree with a partner, and the judgment to know when not to

  • You are fluent in English and French

Our recruitment process

  • First call with Laure, Talent Partner

  • Introduction call with our CEO, to deepdive on the role

  • Case study on a live search: pipeline, gaps and your plan for the next two weeks

  • Interviews with two partners

  • References with hiring managers and candidates you've placed

What's in it for you:

  • Package: €62K to €68K gross/year (base salary of €52K–€57K + 20% annual profit sharing)

  • Opportunity to invest in all Hexa portfolio startups at a (very) preferential rate

  • Swile meal card

  • 8 to 12 RTT days per year

  • Mobility budget: €500/year for green transportation (bike, metro, electric scooter)

  • Health insurance with 50% coverage for you and your family

title: Responsable enquêtes & plaidoyer
description:
Green-Got est une institution financière française qui permet à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance. Nous avons été distingués pour notre exclusion des énergies fossiles par Reclaim Finance, bank.green, Bank for Good ou encore Moralscore. Green-Got est aussi lauréat de l'Impact 40 depuis 3 années consécutives.
Depuis cinq ans, nous montrons où va l'argent. Nos membres ont sorti 300 millions d'euros des grandes banques. Notre mission est de définir de nouveaux standards pour le secteur financier, alignés avec la science, et non pas les intérêts des industries fossiles.

Pourquoi ce recrutement ?
Les banques traditionnelles ont des lobbyistes. Ils défendent leurs profits et les industries qu'elles financent. Les citoyens, eux, n'en ont jamais eu. C'est désormais le cas.
Pendant plusieurs mois, nous avons enquêté sur le financement des pesticides par les banques françaises. Mais dénoncer ne suffit pas : la prochaine étape, c'est la loi. Nous recrutons la personne qui enquêtera à nos côtés, dévoilera ce que le système préfère laisser dans l'ombre et proposera des solutions concrètes pour changer les règles. Elle racontera chaque étape du combat à nos membres, en toute transparence.

Missions

Ton travail tient en trois verbes : enquêter, dévoiler, proposer. Tu portes 2 à 3 grandes campagnes par an, de la première piste jusqu'au texte de loi, et tu les incarnes.

1. Enquêter

  • Faire la veille de l'actualité politique, réglementaire et scientifique (Parlement européen, Assemblée nationale, comitologie, ONG), et nourrir l'équipe Média pour nos contenus réactifs.

  • Repérer les sujets de nos grandes campagnes de mobilisation et les valider avec nous : fludioxonyl, TotalEnergies financé par les Livrets A .

2. Dévoiler

  • Mener les recherches sur les campagnes validées. Ce n'est pas de la réaction à chaud : ce sont 2 à 3 combats de fond par an.

  • Creuser les rapports, les bilans et les sources primaires que personne ne lit, et en sortir des informations inédites.

  • Trouver les angles : quelles personnes interroger (un agriculteur, une famille touchée), comment les contacter, quels contenus en tirer avec l'équipe Média.

  • Incarner l'enquête pendant qu'elle se fait, face caméra et sur le terrain :

  • Prendre la parole face caméra (vidéos, lives, interventions médias) et partager régulièrement où en est le combat.

  • Répondre aux commentaires sur tes sujets et publier dans l'onglet Communauté de l'app. Tu vois comment nos membres réagissent, et cela nourrit tes prochaines enquêtes.

3. Proposer : plaidoyer et lobbying institutionnel

  • Construire la feuille de route plaidoyer à partir de nos enquêtes : quelles demandes, auprès de quelles institutions, avec quel calendrier.

  • Évaluer la faisabilité juridique et politique des leviers possibles : interdire certaines substances, encadrer ou interdire les financements aux producteurs de pesticides, exiger la transparence sur la présence d'entreprises fossiles ou de pesticides dans les produits d'épargne.

  • Repérer les fenêtres déjà ouvertes : renouvellements d'autorisation de substances, textes européens en discussion (Omnibus, décisions du SCoPAFF), propositions de loi, projets de loi de finances.

  • Rédiger les notes de position, propositions d'amendements et argumentaires, toujours adossés à la science et à des données indépendantes.

  • Cartographier et rencontrer les décideurs : Parlement européen, Commission européenne, Représentation permanente de la France, Assemblée nationale, Sénat, ministères, agences et régulateurs. Analyser leurs prises de position et leurs votes passés.

  • Rester strictement apartisan : nos demandes s'appuient sur la science, pas sur un camp.

  • Construire des coalitions avec les ONG, scientifiques, juristes et journalistes, et représenter Green-Got dans les coalitions françaises et européennes de la finance durable (Sustainable Banking Coalition/FEBEA, Impact France, Fair Finance). Une victoire collective reste collective : tes contacts doivent être dans toutes les ONG.

  • Devenir à terme un visage récurrent : « votre lobbyiste à Bruxelles ».

Compétences recherchées

Indispensable

  • Une expérience solide en plaidoyer, affaires publiques ou journalisme d'enquête : ONG, think tank, collaboration parlementaire, cabinet ministériel ou rédaction.

  • Un flair d'enquêteur. Tu sais où chercher l'information que personne n'a sortie (bilans, comitologie, listes de vote, thèses), et tu la vérifies avant de l'affirmer.

  • Une maîtrise en profondeur les deux arènes. Tu connais de l'intérieur le fonctionnement des institutions européennes (commissions, trilogues, comitologie) et du Parlement français (navette, amendements, PLF), et tu as déjà travaillé avec l'autre.

  • Un réseau actif de parlementaires, collaborateurs, conseillers et ONG sur ces sujets.

  • Une plume à deux registres : une note de position qui tient face à un juriste, un post LinkedIn qui tient face à un scroll.

  • De l'aisance face caméra et avec les journalistes. Tu acceptes d'incarner un combat, dans le respect strict des faits.

  • Un fibre en contenus : tu sais quels angles vont attirer l’attention, comment raconter des sujets compliqués…

Un vrai plus

  • Une culture scientifique et réglementaire sur la finance durable et la santé environnementale : taxonomie, SFDR, évaluation des risques, cadre européen d'autorisation des substances.

  • Une expérience dans une ONG de finance climat, ou une connaissance de la régulation financière (règles prudentielles).

  • Une expérience d'animation de coalitions.

Profil recherché

Green-Got est un employeur inclusif. Tous les profils qui se reconnaissent dans cette annonce sont les bienvenus, quels que soient leur parcours, leur genre ou leur origine.

  • Tu vas chercher toi-même.
    Tu ne reprends pas les enquêtes des autres : tu remontes aux sources.

  • Tu arrives avec un dossier.
    Pas seulement une dénonciation : ce qu'il faudrait changer, comment, et avec qui.

  • Tu es crédible partout.
    Dans le bureau d'un conseiller ministériel comme dans une story Instagram.

  • Tu tiens la distance.

title: Senior Scientist — Organoid Model Development
description:
Job description

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world's largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them — and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalised. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

We are looking for a passionate, hands-on Senior Scientist to expand Orakl's biobank to new indications. Working with significant autonomy and reporting to Gizem Altay, Principal Scientist, you will own the establishment of patient-derived organoids from fresh surgical specimens — starting with NSCLC and extending to additional tumour types — from tissue receipt and dissociation through to stable, well-characterised lines ready for downstream applications. You will develop and optimise robust culture protocols, ensure reproducibility across donors, and generate the high-quality biological models that power our AI predictive engine and our partnerships with hospitals and pharma.

Preferred experience

Must have

  • PhD in cancer biology, molecular biology, cell biology, biotechnology, or a related field, as well as 5+ years of hands-on experience, including industry or translational settings.

  • Proven, hands-on experience establishing NSCLC patient-derived organoids from fresh surgical specimens — including tissue handling, dissociation, embedding, and long-term expansion.

  • Strong track record in primary tumour culture, including troubleshooting low take-rates, and donor-to-donor variability and other optimization including: media formulation, matrix selection, passaging strategies, cryopreservation etc.

  • Exceptional wet-lab fundamentals: sterile technique, routine culture, assay development, and QC.

  • Prior experience in building scientific direction, ownership of QC/characterisation strategy, and decision-making

  • Demonstrated ability to independently plan, prioritise, and execute complex experimental pipelines with high quality and reproducibility.

  • Strong analytical and quantitative data-interpretation skills, with clear documentation and reporting.

Nice to have

  • Direct experience collaborating with hospitals, pathology departments, or surgical teams on biospecimen workflows.

  • Experience with drug-response profiling in organoids (dose–response, time-course, combination assays).

  • Knowledge of molecular biology techniques and NGS workflows (WES, RNA-seq) for organoid characterisation and tumour-organoid concordance.

  • Previous responsibility for managing CROs or academic collaborations.

  • Experience mentoring junior scientists or lab technicians, and establishing lab standards.

What will you find at Orakl

  • Mission: Work in a cutting-edge environment, on the bleeding edge of cancer research.

  • Growth opportunities: we’re rapidly expanding the scope of our work and you will be offered multiple opportunities to grow with it!

  • Impact: you’re going to be participating in a fast-growing, multi-faceted project with multiple opportunities to shape it according to your interests.

  • More about Orakl on our Welcome to the Jungle page and on our website

Recruitment steps

  1. Introduction call (20min) – An initial discussion to better understand your background, experiences, and motivations.

  2. Technical Interview (45min) – A deep dive into your technical skills and expertise relevant to the role.

  3. Case Interview (1h) – A case study or problem-solving exercise to assess your strategic thinking and analytical abilities. In-person when possible to meet the team.

  • Reference calls - 2-3 references including at least a direct manager.

  1. Culture Fit Interview (45min) – A conversation with our team to ensure alignment with our company culture, values, and ways of working.

title: Closer
description:
Chez nous, vendre, c'est coacher à la décision. 🎯

Nous sommes convaincus de trois choses :

  • Vous êtes là pour sincèrement aider la personne en face de vous.

  • Sa réussite se trouve souvent en dehors de sa zone de confort.

  • Pour obtenir des résultats différents, il faut oser faire les choses différemment.

Cela implique parfois de confronter les prospects à leurs peurs, leurs contradictions ou leurs croyances limitantes.

Même si c'est inconfortable. 💡

Parfois, votre rôle sera simplement de provoquer une prise de conscience et de les laisser partir. D'autres fois, il faudra aller plus loin pour les aider à regarder la réalité en face.

Toujours avec la même intention : faire ce qui est le mieux pour eux.

Si cette façon de voir la vente vous parle, lisez la suite. 👇

À propos de NextGenLearning 🚀

Chez NextGenLearning, nous accompagnons des personnes qui partent de zéro pour se reconvertir en Data Analyst et décrocher un emploi.

Notre objectif n’est pas de faire une formation de plus, mais de développer un nouveau standard dans notre domaine.

Nous avons construit un produit exceptionnel, qui permet à nos élèves d'obtenir des transformations que beaucoup pensent impossibles.

Et plutôt que de vous demander de nous croire sur parole, voici quelques témoignages de nos élèves : 🎥

  • Barman → Data Analyst : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yTFLTspkOGc

  • BAC+2 → Data Analyst : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jkiycuwroAo

  • Fonctionnaire → Data Analyst (en 8 mois avec famille et boulot en // ) : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oTGsn3x391Y

  • Marketing → Data Project Manager : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lQG_-yspImU

  • Jonathan - Retour après avoir fait des bootcamps pendant 4 ans : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qZqLoWP1RwA

Nous sommes une petite équipe de passionnés, curieux, exigeants avec nous-mêmes, qui aiment le travail bien fait et cherchent constamment à s'améliorer.

Nous grandissons et aujourd’hui, nous recherchons un Closer qui souhaite construire avec nous sur le long terme.

Votre mission 🤝

Nos prospects prennent une décision importante : changer de métier.

Votre rôle est de comprendre leur situation, de leur apporter les connaissances et les perspectives nécessaires, et de les aider à prendre une décision éclairée.

Cela demande de savoir écouter, expliquer, rassurer et parfois confronter leurs idées.

Concrètement :

  • Mener des entretiens de vente avec des prospects qualifiés.

  • Comprendre leurs motivations, leurs freins et leurs objectifs.

  • Présenter notre accompagnement avec pédagogie.

  • Assurer le suivi commercial et le reporting quotidien.

  • Respect de nos process : les leads qualifiés le sont.

  • Participer aux trainings d’équipe pour progresser continuellement.

Conditions 📋

  • Statut : Freelance / Indépendant

  • Lieu : 100% télétravail, d'où vous voulez 🌎

  • Disponibilité : minimum 15h par semaine, dont 10h de calls commerciaux

  • Rémunération : discutée après qualification de votre candidature.


Ce qui compte pour nous, ce sont les résultats, pas les heures travaillées.

Vous êtes libre de vous organiser comme vous le souhaitez. En contrepartie, nous attendons de la fiabilité : tenir vos engagements et être présent dans les moments importants.

Nous voulons être les meilleurs et gagner, mais jamais au détriment de notre santé, de notre famille ou de notre vie personnelle.

title: Full stack engineer
description:
About Nabla

Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes:

Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.

AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems.

Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks.

Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems.

The best of AI at the service of healthcare

Nabla’s phenomenal traction is the result of 3 years of diligent product development.

Led by former Meta AI Research engineers, our team has consistently anticipated how AI can revolutionize healthcare delivery. Our Machine Learning team continually leverages the latest advancements to unlock AI’s full potential in healthcare.

Yann LeCun, Meta’s ex-Chief AI Scientist and Turing award winner, is an advisor to Nabla. He’s now focused on AMI Labs, with whom we have a close partnership.

Engineering at Nabla

Engineering at Nabla is lean, fast-moving, and deeply technical. Our teams span machine learning, native desktop applications, and platform infrastructure to deliver AI into clinical settings reliably and at scale.

Your team

At Nabla, product development is led jointly by Engineering and Product and organized into cross-functional squads, each focused on a specific product area. Squads bring together product managers, designers, engineers of different profiles, and domain experts, and operate with a high level of ownership.

As a Full-stack Engineer, you'll join one of these squads and contribute end to end to a specific part of the product.

The technical challenges

  • Volumetry and efficiency: We handle more than 2.5 million medical encounters per month. Each one is automatically turned into a clinical note sent to the clinician's patient record system, saving thousands of hours of administrative work and giving healthcare professionals more time for their patients.

  • Real-time audio transcription: capturing and streaming audio reliably, from in-person visits as well as video consultations, and turning it into transcripts with very low latency

  • Resilience: keeping the product working on weak or unstable networks, with no data lost and no disruption to the clinician

  • Healthcare integrations: building robust connections to the third-party medical systems clinicians already rely on.

  • Complex AI services: designing and running multi-stage LLM pipelines and agentic workflows at scale, with the reliability and auditability a clinical setting requires

These challenges come with demanding product requirements:

  • Zero friction: clinicians have no time to learn a new tool, so the product must be fast to set up, intuitive, and useful from the very first consultation

  • Trust: what we generate goes into patient records, so quality and reliability are non-negotiable

  • Works everywhere: web, desktop and mobile, in clinics, hospitals or remote consultations

Your impact

  • Build and improve product features across web, desktop and mobile platforms

  • Design and evolve the back-end APIs and services that power them

  • Collaborate closely with Product, ML, and Design to take projects from idea to production

  • Write clean, maintainable code and contribute to team best practices

  • Learn from senior engineers and grow your skills across the stack

Your DNA

  • Solid foundations in Computer Science

  • 4+ years of industry experience in full-stack engineering

  • Proficient in React (strong Vue.js experience also considered)

  • Proficient in at least one back-end language such as Java, Kotlin, Scala, C#/.NET, Go, or Rust. We use Kotlin internally, and it's fine if you haven't worked with it yet

  • Comfortable working with AI coding tools and agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, etc.), and keen to use AI in your day-to-day work

  • Curious, eager to learn, and motivated to grow in a fast-moving team

  • Care about code quality and maintainability

  • Enjoy working in an international team where English is our primary language

Our Stack

  • Frontend: TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, Rust, Electron

  • Backend: Kotlin / JVM, GraphQL, PostgreSQL

  • ML & Infra: Python, PyTorch, Slurm, GCP, Terraform, Kubernetes

Where you'll be based

Our offices are based in Paris 3e (Arts & Métiers)

Remote policy: 2 days a week

Possibility of working abroad remotely up to 2 weeks, once a year.

Benefits

Just like we’re dedicated to supporting doctors’ well-being, ensuring yours is a top priority. We firmly believe that by prioritizing your well-being, we support you to excel in your work.

Here are the benefits you get when joining Nabla:

  • Stock ownership

  • 100% healthcare coverage

  • Meal vouchers

  • Public transportation costs covered at 50%

  • Exercise class during the workday: Yoga, running, pilates, HIIT

  • Unlimited budget for book purchases, so you can continue to learn about ML / Healthcare

  • Culture of trust & accountability — your output matters more than your clock-in time

Life at Nabla

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed.

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off. We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment and financial scam which uses Nabla to collect personal information. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure they are utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity. You can find more information following this link.


Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

title: Customer Success Manager Grands Comptes - Cabinets comptables H/F
description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Le rôle

En tant que Customer Success Manager Key Accounts (CSM KA), tu accompagnes un portefeuille de cabinets partenaires grands comptes (7 à 10 comptes, Top 150) qui déploient Pennylane auprès de leurs équipes et de leurs clients. Ton objectif : maximiser l’adoption, la satisfaction et la rétention, tout en structurant une gouvernance adaptée à des organisations multi-bureaux.

Tes responsabilités

  • Piloter la relation au quotidien avec les décisionnaires et équipes projet du cabinet.

  • Construire et animer la gouvernance : COPIL, comités d’adoption, instances de suivi, communauté de relais locaux.

  • Définir et exécuter des plans d’adoption (collaborateurs + clients) fondés sur la donnée.

  • Coordonner l’exécution avec les expert·e·s internes Pennylane (Produit, Support, Ops, Sales, etc.).

  • Anticiper les risques (satisfaction, déploiement, adoption) et mettre en place des plans de remédiation.

  • Contribuer à l’inscription et à l’usage de la PA Pennylane pour centraliser les flux.

Ce que tu vas faire concrètement

1) Stratégie d’embarquement clients (TPE/PME)

  • Conseiller les cabinets sur la communication, l’activation et la formation des clients.

  • Aider à intégrer les enjeux de facture électronique dans le plan d’embarquement.

  • Suivre l’exécution post-déploiement et proposer des actions correctives.

2) Adoption et usage côté collaborateurs

  • Mesurer l’usage et identifier les leviers d’amélioration.

  • Mettre en place des plans d’action et en piloter l’exécution.

3) Satisfaction & rétention

  • Maintenir une relation de confiance, cadrer les attentes et délivrer de la valeur.

  • Déployer des plans d’action stratégiques (annuels / semestriels) avec les partenaires.

Indicateurs de réussite

  • CSAT sur ton portefeuille.

  • Progression de l’adoption (collaborateurs et clients), suivie en COPIL.

  • Qualité de la gouvernance et autonomie des relais locaux.

  • Réduction des risques et amélioration de la rétention.

 
 

Profil recherché

 

  • Expérience de 5 ans minimum :

    • en Customer Success SaaS avec de bonnes bases comptables (ou motivé(e) à monter en compétences à ce sujet

    • ou en finance / audit avec gestion de relation clients (dimension commerciale)

  • Excellente relation client : capacité à rassurer, structurer, et prendre de la hauteur.

  • Assertivité : recommandations claires, diplomatie et capacité à convaincre.

  • Pilotage de portefeuille (santé client), plans d’action ad hoc.

  • Analyse de données : tirer des insights et prioriser.

  • Gestion de projet : coordination multi-interlocuteurs, rigueur et autonomie.

 
 

Process de recrutement

 

  • Premier entretien avec Florent Mirigay - Senior Business Recruiter (45 min)

  • Deuxième entretien avec Alexandra Ser, Team lead de l’équipe CSM Grands Comptes (45min)

  • Etude de cas (préparée en amont) avec Alexandra et une personne de l’équipe CSM Grands Comptes (1H)

  • Dernier entretien avec Arnaud Bernard (Head of Grands Comptes)

 

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

  • Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

  • Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

  • Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

  • Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

Ton objectif : maximiser l’adoption, la satisfaction et la rétention, tout en structurant une gouvernance adaptée à des organisations multi-bureaux.

Tes responsabilités

  • Construire et animer la gouvernance : COPIL, comités d’adoption, instances de suivi, communauté de relais locaux.

  • Définir et exécuter des plans d’adoption (collaborateurs + clients) fondés sur la donnée.

  • Coordonner l’exécution avec les expert·e·s internes Pennylane (Produit, Support, Ops, Sales, etc.).

  • Anticiper les risques (satisfaction, déploiement, adoption) et mettre en place des plans de remédiation.

  • Contribuer à l’inscription et à l’usage de la PA Pennylane pour centraliser les flux.

Ce que tu vas faire concrètement

1) Stratégie d’embarquement clients (TPE/PME)

  • Conseiller les cabinets sur la communication, l’activation et la formation des clients.

  • Aider à intégrer les enjeux de facture électronique dans le plan d’embarquement.

  • Suivre l’exécution post-déploiement et proposer des actions correctives.

2) Adoption et usage côté collaborateurs

  • Mesurer l’usage et identifier les leviers d’amélioration.

  • Mettre en place des plans d’action et en piloter l’exécution.

3) Satisfaction & rétention

  • Maintenir une relation de confiance, cadrer les attentes et délivrer de la valeur.

  • Déployer des plans d’action stratégiques (annuels / semestriels) avec les partenaires.

Indicateurs de réussite

  • CSAT sur ton portefeuille.

  • Progression de l’adoption (collaborateurs et clients), suivie en COPIL.

  • Qualité de la gouvernance et autonomie des relais locaux.

  • Réduction des risques et amélioration de la rétention.

 
 

Profil recherché

 

  • Expérience de 5 ans minimum :

    • en Customer Success SaaS avec de bonnes bases comptables (ou motivé(e) à monter en compétences à ce sujet

    • ou en finance / audit avec gestion de relation clients (dimension commerciale)

  • Excellente relation client : capacité à rassurer, structurer, et prendre de la hauteur.

  • Assertivité : recommandations claires, diplomatie et capacité à convaincre.

  • Pilotage de portefeuille (santé client), plans d’action ad hoc.

  • Analyse de données : tirer des insights et prioriser.

  • Gestion de projet : coordination multi-interlocuteurs, rigueur et autonomie.

  • Premier entretien avec Florent Mirigay - Senior Business Recruiter (45 min)

  • Deuxième entretien avec Alexandra Ser, Team lead de l’équipe CSM Grands Comptes (45min)

  • Etude de cas (préparée en amont) avec Alexandra et une personne de l’équipe CSM Grands Comptes (1H)

  • Dernier entretien avec Arnaud Bernard (Head of Grands Comptes)

  • Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

title: Growth Engineer - Data & Tracking
description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

Your impact

Great growth decisions start with reliable data.

At Pennylane, we're building the financial operating system for European businesses. As we grow and expand into new markets, understanding how users discover, interact with and adopt our product is becoming increasingly important.

That's where Growth Engineering comes in.

We're looking for a Growth Engineer with strong data and tracking expertise to help us build reliable, scalable tracking and analytics foundations across our digital acquisition journeys.

You'll join our Growth Engineering team and work closely with Thomas, our Growth Engineering Team Lead, within the Marketing Website squad.

Your mission ? Make sure we collect the right data, trust what we measure and turn insights into better growth decisions.

What you'll do

Build reliable tracking foundations

You'll own the technical implementation and reliability of tracking across our website and acquisition funnels.

  • Design, implement and maintain tracking plans across key user journeys.

  • Build and improve event tracking, user identification and data collection.

  • Work with tools such as Segment, Amplitude and Google Tag Manager.

  • Ensure tracking consistency, accuracy and reliability across our digital ecosystem.

  • Identify and resolve tracking issues before they impact business decisions.

Connect data across our growth ecosystem

You'll help build the technical connections between our website, internal systems and analytics tools.

  • Develop and maintain APIs and integrations between platforms.

  • Ensure reliable data flows between our acquisition, product and analytics tools.

  • Collaborate with Data teams to improve data quality and consistency.

  • Support the evolution of our tracking architecture as Pennylane scales internationally.

Power experimentation and conversion

You'll work closely with Growth, Marketing and Data teams to understand user behavior and improve acquisition performance.

  • Implement the technical foundations for A/B testing and experimentation.

  • Help measure acquisition funnels and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Ensure experiments are properly tracked and measurable.

  • Translate business questions into clear technical tracking requirements.

  • Support data-driven decisions through reliable instrumentation.

Contribute as an engineer

This is an engineering role, not a reporting or dashboarding position.

You'll be expected to bring strong technical fundamentals and take ownership of your work.

  • Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code.

  • Build scalable and reliable technical solutions.

  • Investigate complex tracking and data issues.

  • Improve existing systems, processes and documentation.

  • Collaborate with engineers across Growth, Engineering and Data teams.

  • Contribute to technical decisions and engineering best practices.

Who are you?

We're looking for an engineer who understands both how data is collected and why it matters.

Someone who enjoys solving technical problems, working with different teams and making sure that business decisions are based on data people can trust.

You don't need to be a data scientist or a marketing specialist. But you should be comfortable working at the intersection of software engineering, analytics and growth.

We'd love to meet you if...

  • You have a software engineering experience, with hands-on exposure to tracking, analytics or data integrations.

  • You have implemented and maintained event tracking across websites, applications or acquisition funnels.

  • You're fluent in AI-assisted development : you work with coding agents, create custom skills and instructions, use worktrees to parallelize work and keep code quality high.

  • You're familiar with tools such as Segment, Amplitude, Google Tag Manager or similar platforms.

  • You understand event schemas, data layers, user identification and tracking consistency.

  • You're comfortable working with JavaScript and APIs to implement and troubleshoot tracking.

  • You care about code quality, reliability and maintainability.

  • You enjoy taking ownership of technical projects, from design to production.

  • You're comfortable working in French and English.

Bonus points if you have experience with:

  • Ruby on Rails, Vue.js or Nuxt.js.

  • SQL and data warehouses.

  • Server-side tracking and conversion APIs.

  • A/B testing and experimentation platforms.

  • Attribution, conversion measurement or acquisition analytics.

  • Privacy-conscious tracking and consent management.

  • International websites and multi-market acquisition funnels.

Our technical environment

Our Growth Engineering team works with:

  • Frontend: JavaScript, Vue.js, Nuxt.js

  • Backend: Ruby on Rails

  • Database: PostgreSQL

  • Development: Git, GitHub

  • Analytics & Tracking: Segment, Amplitude and other analytics tools, depending on the project

You'll collaborate closely with our Data teams and contribute to the evolution of our growth tracking infrastructure.

Why you'll love this role

  • Real impact: Your work will help teams understand how users discover and adopt Pennylane.

  • Technical ownership: You'll contribute to the architecture and reliability of our tracking ecosystem.

  • Engineering standards: You'll work on technical challenges that require the same level of rigor as our other engineering teams.

  • Cross-functional exposure: You'll collaborate with Growth, Marketing, Engineering and Data.

  • International scale: You'll help build the data foundations needed to support our expansion across Europe.

  • Continuous improvement: You'll have room to challenge existing implementations, propose better solutions and improve how we measure growth.

If you enjoy building reliable data foundations and want to see your engineering work directly influence growth decisions, we'd love to meet you.

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

  • To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

  • To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

  • To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

We're the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $1B in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. About the role

This is the GTM Account Executive role for Europe. You will be our first dedicated seller for the region, responsible for turning Europe's agencies, brands, production companies and media groups into Higgsfield customers: sourcing and closing the first European deals yourself and owning the accounts after signature. You work with our Almaty-based GTM team, our US-based Enterprise team, and directly with company leadership.

What you will work on

  • End-to-end sales execution: identify, pitch, negotiate, and close deals with European agencies, brands and B2B partners, from first touch through signature.

  • Processes at scale: build the repeatable playbook that the next European hires will follow.

Your must haves

  • Proven experience in B2B SaaS sales and/or account management with measurable results.

  • Experience selling into advertising agencies, brand marketing organisations, or media and entertainment companies in at least two European markets.

  • An existing network of senior buyers in European agencies, brands or media groups.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken. A second major European language is a strong plus.

  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and closing skills.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage sales data and metrics for decision-making.

  • Ability to work in a high-growth startup environment.

Nice to haves

  • Big3/Big4 consulting experience or equivalent top-tier professional background is a strong plus.

  • Experience selling AI, GenAI, or ML products.

  • Experience in early-stage, fast-scaling startups.

  • Exposure to upselling, cross-selling, and customer success strategies.

  • Relationships in European broadcasters, streamers or sports media.

  • Existing network of enterprise clients or partners in SaaS/AI ecosystems.

  • Competitive base salary in USD.

  • Our GTM team works six days a week and overlaps with US hours. Expect the same pace wherever you are based.

  • Full-time position.

  • Opportunity to become the cornerstone of Higgsfield's European sales engine.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups.

We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.

Help us take Wingtra’s new product platforms from fast prototypes to reliable series production. Embedded in the engineering team, you own mechanical design, qualification and industrialization through initial ramp-up. Together we deliver a qualified product, a complete product file and a working production line. We are early adopters of AI and actively build agentic workflows across engineering, from design and test planning to execution and analysis.

Responsibilities

  • Take a new aircraft from concept to series production. You work in a small team with electronics designers and test engineers. You get direct feedback from prototypes, flight tests and production builds.

  • Design and iterate lightweight parts. You design, build and test parts and assemblies, then improve them until they are ready for production.

  • Choose materials and processes with care. You balance performance, volumes, unit cost, tooling investment and lead times.

  • Own DFX. You design for manufacturing, assembly, quality, cost and serviceability, and you settle tolerances, interfaces and process constraints early.

  • Work hand in hand with suppliers. You partner with sourcing on technical feasibility, tooling and part iterations.

  • Own qualification. You qualify parts with the intended production materials and processes, and you agree product-specific acceptance criteria with the test engineers.

  • Deliver the production-ready product file. CAD, 2D drawings, tolerances, BOMs, material and process specifications and acceptance criteria.

  • Hand over a running line. Once the qualification gates have passed and ramp-up is complete, you hand the line and the product file to Production and Production Engineering.


    • Requirements

  • You have several years of experience taking mechanical products through the full lifecycle: prototype, series production and quality monitoring at the customer. Ideally on structurally critical products at volumes of hundreds to a few thousand units.

  • You are strong in CAD (Solidworks/PDM preferred), tolerance analysis and material selection.

  • You have practical experience with injection molding as well as additive manufacturing for functional plastic parts.

  • You prototype fast and pragmatically, then qualify and document with discipline.

  • You like hands-on work: builds, testing and working with suppliers.

  • You use AI for design exploration, qualification planning and data analysis. You check its output, share new workflows and keep raising the team’s bar.

  • You are curious, flexible and collaborative, with a real drive to build the next great thing.
